findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：McKesson 宣布將 Medical-Surgical Solutions 分拆為獨立公司，並於 2026-04-20 與 Apollo 基金簽約，以約 $12.5 億可轉換特別股取得該部門約 13% 少數股權，待監管核准。
findings.excerpt: During fiscal 2026, we announced our intention to separate this segment into an independent company. As a part of the separation strategy, on April 20, 2026, we announced a definitive agreement under which funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management, Inc. (“Apollo Funds”) will acquire approximately 13% minority ownership interest in our Medical‑Surgical Solutions segment through an investment of approximately $1.25 billion in the segment’s convertible preferred equity.

findings.claim: 10-K 列示 Oncology & Multispecialty 部門服務包含 direct to patient pharmacy 能力與 InspiroGene 細胞與基因治療服務；競爭段亦列出製造商直接配送（manufacturers engaged in direct distribution）為競爭者之一。
findings.excerpt: we face strong competition from international, national, regional, and local full-line, short-line, and specialty distributors; service merchandisers; self-warehousing chain drugstores; manufacturers engaged in direct distribution; third-party logistics companies; and large payer organizations.

findings.claim: 產業文章稱 2026 年中品牌平台處方占比上升，顯示直接面向病患通路遷移（廠商視角），未量化對批發商影響。
findings.source: Pharmaceutical Commerce, Mid-year check-in: how direct-to-patient momentum is accelerating
